name: nse-bse-trading
description: Day trading skills for Indian markets (NSE/BSE), ported from Jake Schincariol's day-trader-skill

plugins.name: nse-bse-trading
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading on NSE and BSE: a scanner over every listed stock, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager with circuit limits and ASM/GSM, a budget manager with Indian charges, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, a results analyst and an insider-trading tracker.
